limitations: The usable evidence concerns one advertising campaign.
News reports are used because the relevant full primary results could not be retrieved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Regular audiences will find AI-generated video with visual hallucinations deeply offensive rather than ignore it.

statement.excerpt: The assumption is that audiences are stupid, and ignorant, and "just won't care," and I firmly disagree — I think regular people will find this stuff deeply offensive.

from_speaker: will find this stuff deeply offensive
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns ordinary viewers' strong negative reactions to visibly erroneous AI-generated video, not merely opposition to AI or concern about artists' employment.
Regular people means a broadly representative audience, rather than a self-selected set of online commenters.
Deeply offensive means strong aversion or offense; noticing an error, disliking an advertisement or identifying AI use is insufficient by itself.
criteria.support_condition: Representative audience studies consistently find strong offense attributable to visible visual errors across multiple AI-generated videos.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative studies across such videos find that viewers generally tolerate or ignore the errors, with little strong offense even when the errors are noticed.
